subject: Acme POC kickoff recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Blake <oliver.blake@acme.com>, Dana Singh <dana.singh@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T15:00:00Z
Subject: Acme POC kickoff recap and next steps

Hi Oliver / Dana —

Thanks again for a productive kickoff earlier today. Per our call, I wanted to confirm the scope, success metrics, owners, and near-term setup tasks so we're aligned going into the pilot. I've attached the SOW draft and an access checklist.

Summary of pain points you described:
- High latency and cost on open-ended generation calls for customer-facing features (support assistant and knowledge search).
- Quality regressions when moving to smaller model sizes; need predictable tradeoffs.
- Auditability and data retention controls for regulated use cases.

POC objectives (agreed):
1) Validate latency and cost improvements using Redwood batching and caching for the support-assistant flow. Target: median latency < 500ms for 512-token windows and 30% token-unit cost reduction vs current baseline.
2) Maintain quality: top-line score on your evaluation prompt set no worse than 5% drop vs baseline. We'll run redwood-eval on your prompt set.
3) Verify security/compliance controls for logs and KMS integration during the pilot.

Scope and deliverables:
- Environment: Dedicated POC on Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) in us-east-1.
- Model(s): start with Llama-2-70B-availability variant (quantized) and a smaller 13B variant for fallback testing.
- Prompt set & evals: we'll run your support-assistant prompt set (~200 prompts) plus 50 red-team prompts. Aditya will own ingestion and evals.
- Success metrics: latency percentiles, cost per 1k tokens, eval pass rate, and error/noise rate in logs.

Owners and timeline:
- Customer PM: Oliver Blake (Acme) — overall signoff
- Customer Eng: Dana Singh (Acme) — infra & access
- Redwood AE: Marissa Cole — project coordination and commercial
- Redwood SE: Aditya Rao — technical lead, evals, kernel/config tuning
- Redwood CS: Laura Bennett — onboarding and runbooks
- Security/Compliance: Rishi Malhotra — KMS and audit log checklist

Timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): access + account link, sign SOW draft, confirm prompt set
- Week 1: environment provisioning, initial model load, smoke tests
- Week 2: eval runs + performance tuning
- Week 3: joint review & go/no-go, recommendations for production rollout

Immediate next steps (please action):
1) Oliver / Dana: confirm you're good with the above scope and the attached SOW by EOD Friday (2026-06-12).
2) Dana: provide AWS role/ARN or a read-only test dataset access per the attached access checklist.
3) I'll send a DocuSign link for the SOW once you confirm minor commercial items.

Attachments: acme-poc-sow.pdf, redwood-access-checklist.md
Drive plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d5e6f/acme-poc-plan
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-POC-42

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Oliver Blake <oliver.blake@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Singh <dana.singh@acme.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T17:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff recap and next steps

Marissa — thanks for the detailed recap. Confirming that the scope and metrics look right to me. A couple quick clarifications:
- The latency target looks good; can you confirm the measurement method (server-side end-to-end vs token-emission)? Prefer server-side end-to-end for our reporting.
- For the prompt set: I'll share the canonical support-assistant CSV (200 prompts) by tomorrow morning.

Dana will send the AWS role ARN and a short list of endpoints we want in scope. We expect legal/procurement to review the SOW, but we should be able to sign by the end of next week.

Oliver Blake
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
oliver.blake@acme.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Oliver Blake <oliver.blake@acme.com>, Dana Singh <dana.singh@acme.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T09:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff recap and next steps

Thanks Marissa / Oliver — quick technical notes and ask from the SE side:
- Latency measurement: we'll report server-side request-to-last-token-emitted P50/P95/P99. I'll include end-to-end client observed timings if you can run a quick client-side trace.
- Model variants: to test graceful degradation I recommend the initial run use 70B-quant (for quality) and a 13B-quant fallback. I'll put together kernel/quant config that balances throughput and memory.
- Access: Dana, please create an IAM role with the following minimum: read-only S3 access to the prompt set bucket, sts:AssumeRole from redwood-poc@redwood-account, and CloudWatch read for logs. If you prefer we can use a pre-signed upload link for the prompt set.
- Evals: please confirm you want the 200 canonical prompts plus 50 negative (red-team) prompts. We'll run both generative and rerank evals and post results in the Drive folder.

I'll start a short runbook for onboarding steps and link to it in the Drive.

- Aditya
Staff SE, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Blake <oliver.blake@acme.com>, Dana Singh <dana.singh@acme.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Acme POC kickoff recap and next steps

Appreciate the quick replies — short update with a few action items and a DocuSign link for the SOW.

Updates:
- Measurement: agreed — we'll publish server-side request-to-last-token-emitted metrics P50/P95/P99 and include client-side traces if Acme can run them.
- Prompt set: Oliver, thanks — we'll expect the CSV tomorrow. Aditya will confirm the ingestion path.
- Access: Dana, please either send the IAM role ARN to aditya@redwood.com or upload the prompt set to the pre-signed link I'll send privately.
- SOW: sending DocuSign now: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ACME-POC-SOW — can Procurement / Legal review and sign next week.

Next meeting: let's reconvene for a 30-minute tech sync on Wednesday 2026-06-17 14:00 ET to review access, confirm prompt set ingestion, and validate the smoke test plan. I'll send a calendar invite.

Action items summary:
- Oliver: confirm server-side measurement wording (done) and approve timeline (please confirm).
- Dana: provide IAM role ARN or upload prompt set.
- Procurement: review SOW via DocuSign.
- Aditya: prepare runbook + initial kernel config for the two model variants.

Thanks everyone — I'll track these in HubSpot and the shared Drive.

Best,
Marissa Cole
